body:
This change improves the user experience on case-sensitive filesystems (e.g., Linux) by allowing the  environment variable to resolve file paths case-insensitively.

Previously, the code converted the file path specified in the environment variable to lower case which did not match the file on disk, which could be inconvenient. This commit introduces a case-insensitive lookup to find the correct file, making the feature more robust.

Fixes #4506
